case.pattern_description: Multiple online purchases within minutes on a proxy desktop device, deviating from the card's usual in-person usage, matching prior confirmed card-not-present fraud on same card and device.

evidence.claim: Three online transactions within 20 minutes on a proxy desktop device
Prior confirmed fraud case on same card and device (AGENT-HHG-006)

case.summary: The card C07297-K1, normally used for in-person purchases, was used for three high-value online transactions within a 20-minute window from a proxy desktop device. The customer reported the last transaction as unauthorized. Prior confirmed fraud cases on the same card and device corroborate a card-not-present fraud pattern. The combined exposure of $1,427.12 exceeds the SAR filing threshold. The evidence strongly indicates fraudulent activity.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer states they did not make the $482.12 purchase and still has the card.

R6: shared device links other cards

sar.narrative: Card-not-present fraud on a proxy device with multiple online authorizations, confirmed by prior cases.
